name: mychat
description: A private AI playground — Cloudflare Workers + OpenRouter, with a self-updating model list

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Your OpenRouter API key. Create one at [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys); it looks like `sk-or-v1-...`. It is stored server-side only and never reaches the browser.

MASTER_PASSWORD.description: The master password for signing in — **only you should know it**. Use something strong (16+ random characters); `openssl rand -base64 24` will generate one.
